program_binding.phase_outcome: High-value claims are demonstrated through compact, reproducible proof objects rather than volume theater.
program_binding.phase_exit_gate: The six declared proof classes exist, are public-safe, and link back to current evidence rows.

leaf_audit.outcome: Limen demonstrates governed multi-agent delivery through architecture, decisions, failure modes, metrics, and limits.
leaf_audit.acceptance: Every report claim resolves to a dated evidence row and an independent reviewer returns publishable or explicit findings.
residual_gates: report source and independent review receipt

leaf_audit.outcome: Existing profile, portfolio, resume, organization, and repository copy cannot contradict the report or ledger.
leaf_audit.acceptance: The public-surface audit reports zero unsupported, contradictory, private, or stale material claims.
residual_gates: corrected source copy if drift exists

leaf_audit.outcome: The commercial claim is grounded in delivery economics and control behavior, not only software output.
leaf_audit.acceptance: Analysis regenerates from documented inputs and distinguishes model cost, human time, retries, and failed work.

leaf_audit.outcome: Visitors and reviewers can see recent proof that selected systems still work.
leaf_audit.acceptance: Every selected flagship has a fresh exact-head predicate receipt or an explicit not-current status.

leaf_audit.outcome: The governed system can be understood visually and interactively without exposing private operations or secrets.
leaf_audit.acceptance: Demo passes synthetic-only, no-secret, accessibility, responsive, and link-health checks.
residual_gates: browser, accessibility, privacy, responsive, and link receipts

leaf_audit.outcome: Third-party observations, reviews, reproductions, or outcomes provide evidence beyond self-authored claims.
leaf_audit.acceptance: At least two independent validation objects exist or the outreach outcomes and objections are durably recorded.
residual_gates: two consented independent objects or durable outreach outcome ledger

formalization_gate.rule: PSP-P02 is formally closed. This contract may formalize only after PSP-C03 closes with predicate-backed receipts; PSP-P03-W07 is its sole unsatisfied leaf.
automatic_after_dependencies: refresh every branch and source exact head
resolve every candidate claim against the merged claims ledger and evidence index
mark failed or expired sources withheld

resolver_order: observed exact head or immutable receipt
withheld_classes: adoption, usage, install, or customer counts without primary receipts
revenue, payment, or commercial outcomes without primary receipts
rankings, percentiles, or top-percent claims without an independent reproducible basis
private implementation, repository, customer, or partner details
zero-maintenance, autonomous-forever, or reliability implications not measured by the cited source

flagships.name: Limen
flagships.candidate_claim: Governed multi-agent delivery with public operating, failure, and verification receipts.
limitations: Internal operation is not customer adoption.
Task counts are dated snapshots, not reliability or outcome rates.

flagships.name: UCC Public-Records Intelligence Platform
flagships.candidate_claim: Four implemented state collectors sit on a broader public-record architecture.
limitations: Four collectors do not establish fifty-state deployment.
A public surface does not establish adoption or data completeness.

flagships.name: AI Chat Exporter
flagships.candidate_claim: Client-side conversation export is available across five named portable formats.
limitations: Feature count does not establish installs, daily use, revenue, or retention.
Privacy claims stay bounded to the inspectable client-side export path.

inputs: published price basis or explicit unknown
forbidden_shortcuts: treating failed or blocked work as zero cost
converting list price to actual spend
cost_failure_reproduction.publication_rule: Withhold the analysis when attribution, sampling, privacy, or denominator checks fail.

exact_head_receipt_plan.rule: Every selected flagship receives one fresh exact-head receipt or an explicit not-current outcome; a README assertion or endpoint 200 is insufficient.

synthetic_architecture_demo.dataset: invented non-personal packet, lease, receipt, failure, and recovery records

acceptable_objects: accepted talk or publication with review provenance
external_validation.send_rule: No request, outreach, upload, or publication occurs from this preflight.
